verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated 'writing-skills' SKILL.md that documents a process for authoring new skills (write test cases, watch fail, write documentation, watch tests pass, refactor) rather than requiring reverse-engineering existing skills, and a runtime probe confirms SKILL.md files use a 'name' frontmatter field that can be installed/read cleanly. However, no evidence explicitly shows a blank/template SKILL.md scaffold with both name AND description frontmatter fields spelled out for new authors. Missing for 10: an explicit template file or scaffold command, confirmation of a 'description' frontmatter field, and independent/hands-on evidence of someone authoring a new skill from scratch using only the documented template.
